faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CSMCRI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the CSIR CSMCRI Project Associate-I position is 09 September 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Civil Engineering from a university recognized by the government to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Associate-I position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 31,000, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the CSIR CSMCRI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. You should prepare your application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I position will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for Project Associate-I posts on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the CSIR CSMCRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR CSMCRI is located in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 364002.
